segments.en: No, no, other than is Gautam, your name.
Usually my ID, it's what comes.
Okay, okay. I am also married.
I asked and asked, so [laughs] No, listening to your voice, it didn't look like you were married, so I asked.
I shifted here five months ago.
Okay, where are you in Salem?
So leave it, it's okay, let it be. Why does it matter?
Should I not speak? Should I not say 31?
It's not like that, it's not like that.
If you're okay, then tell me.
Your voice is nice. Thank you.
No, you were asking something, tell me. I was asking something else, then I asked you quickly.
I am not asking anything. Wife where?
So you came here and are staying alone as if it's a honeymoon, right?
As far as you are concerned, you are staying alone like a honeymoon.
Why are you saying like that?
Oh, I have come permanently now, ah?
How many kids do you have?
Only one daughter, three years old.
It's been three or four years since marriage, ah?
At this time you are speaking so clearly, is your voice echoing? Echo is heard.
What were you doing? Were you sleeping?
No, no, I am just holding the mouthpiece near my phone and talking with my mouth.
Are you staying with your in-laws or are you staying separately?
Separately. For me, my mother-in-law and father-in-law, both are not there. They passed away.
How are you staying here alone without anyone, taking a room?
Taking a room, taking a house.
Oh, is it? You took a house?
Actually, I have my own house here. Near my mother's side, I have my own house.
Ah, it has some construction work. That has some pending work to be finished.
So, until then, I took a rental house and am staying. They are all supporting me.
That's what I asked, without anyone how are you staying with support? I asked like that.
It's not like that. They are there. Near me, everyone, mother, grandfather, grandmother, mother, father, uncle's family, aunt's family, uncle's family,
Okay, I asked. That's why you are alone in Attur, I asked. That's why.
This is the town I was born and brought up in. Actually, I am married in Chennai for 10 years.
After 10 years, I have come now.
No. For now, no work. Kids are small, you see.
How long have you been using the app?
I installed it a long time ago, but I am not a regular user. I come occasionally.
Same here. When my wife goes out, I use it. Otherwise, I don't come. I am married.
With your wife, you are so scared.
Not scared, why unnecessarily have problems like that?
It's okay. Not too strict, not too liberal either. Okay, to an extent.
Not really like that, 70%. 30% I don't like, that's why we keep fighting sometimes.
[laughs] What did you study, and what did your wife study?
I'm BE Mechanical. She is MSc BEd.
So since you have a kid, you don't go to work, you go when you can.
Going on like that. What about you? How is your wife?
My wife doesn't suit me at all.
From the beginning, it's like that. Her character, not just for me, doesn't suit anyone else.
I am not saying this just to complain. She is really a very good human being.
She has immense human qualities. Tremendous health-consciousness. One of the best fathers in the world, best son, a good disciple to a guru.
But if you ask if she's a good wife, that doesn't suit her.
Because her growing style is different. There's a huge age gap between us.
Her growing style, in that generation, women, how their mothers lived, that is, whatever anyone says, without replying back, hiding behind the door and replying, like that.
The same thing she expects from me. How is that possible?
[laughs] You are of this generation gap, so how can you stay in that generation?
If I say, 'Hey, bring tea, bring coffee,' she will say, if I say my name and ask for tea, we should say it 10 times, like, 'Please give tea,' then she will give.
If we say it like that, she will give. If we just say, 'Bring tea,' she won't.
If we say, 'Please do this,' she will do. If we think we should do it, she won't do it.

That is her nature. She speaks like that, her tone, voice, everything for us, because I am also educated. I am also educated, I am a fairly good person, what is the point of living like this? That's why I am saying.
That's a big issue. Then, actually, even in such a sad matter, you are smiling and talking, it changes quickly.
Why? Because I got used to it now.
I got used to it, because I came out of him.
In my mind, he is not clean, because he brought me to that level.
That is, now, how do you know?
One, one, one thing you say, you will understand completely.
Like now, if people come to our house in Chennai, people come to do house work, wash vessels, clean the house, and go. They will come and go.
Until then, he talks nicely to me, smiling and talking in the morning.
Then my tone changes, 'Vengai' tone, 'Vendhuan' tone, 'Dhatri' tone,
Then, I think, we were talking so nicely just now, why does someone else—not someone else, but one person in front of me—make me feel insulted?
your wife, you in front of another person, a third person, want to insult? When you think like that, there is no love in you, that's what it means.
Really, if you had love, you wouldn't do such a thing.
Even if you do it, within four walls we can talk, but in front of others, you shouldn't do it.
No, like that, it has happened, right? A mistake has happened.
No, something wrong has happened, I am asking.
No, you might have done something like that, or he might have done something like that, I am asking.
Ah, like this many things have happened.
This is how he treats me, this is the way.
I never took money from his pocket.
Ah, why would I take money from his pocket? In front of them, he shouts, 'You are living by taking money from my pocket,' like that.
Why would I take money from his pocket? I have no need for that. Do I lack anything?
How many times should I tell him not to take money from my pocket? He doesn't listen.
If you say it once, won't he understand? He keeps doing it.
If you say, 'Bring tea,' he won't bring. If you say, 'Please bring tea,' he will bring.
With such a person, how can we live?
He will never give a divorce.
Why? You are just roaming around. Come on, let's roam.
No, I am asking normally. There is nothing wrong, right? If you share, you can share. If you want, we can be friends.
We can be friends, but beyond that, I don't want any other relationship.
If you want, you can tell me directly, there is no problem.
If you want to be friends, tell me.
Ah, it's friendship. To be honest, I am a bit busy. Because I have kids to pick up and drop, and other work, after that, in the evening, I take tuition.
So, I'm saying, I will tell you. Whenever you are free, we can talk with an open mind, no problem.
My problem is this. I don't have time. After that, I am eager to share things with you, but I share my ID, and you share yours, so we can let each other know.
No, all that is not needed. Just share your number, I'll send a WhatsApp 'Hi'.
No number needed. I can give my Telegram ID.
No, actually, I am telling you, my wife uses it, that's why I am saying. Otherwise, I would have given it, no problem.
Yes, everyone uses WhatsApp and Telegram. I will use it now. If you give, I'll save it. That's all, nothing else.
My problem is this. I have that fear, that's the thing.
No, it's nothing. If you give a number, I will just say 'Hi' and put it. You are free to call me anytime.
The rest is up to you, it's not a big deal. Because I said so, you will drink?
We can talk, talk, talk for a bit.
A little time. I need a bit of time.
No, take your time, please cut it and put it. After you said that, I got a weird feeling, so I asked you quickly.
You are feeling so hurt, right? That's why I asked you immediately.
Ah, yes, it's there. I came out of it.
How to say it? It happened like that.
Now I am hurt? I am hurt, I asked, so I am not hurt.
Because I am expecting a word from him, if he expected it, then I would feel pain.
What did you eat at night?
When did you sleep? When will you wake up in the morning?
Today I woke up. Tomorrow I won't wake up early. Tomorrow I won't wake up early, I am telling you.
Sharmila, cut and don't worry. Share the number and go, please.
Actually, I cannot speak. Is it okay for you?
No, I am messaging, you can call whenever you are free. There is no problem.
Let me repeat the number once again.
Yes, that number is correct. DP didn't come.
Wait a minute, save it. I'll message you.
I haven't shared my number with anyone.
How should I call you? What? I will tell you everything in detail on WhatsApp.
Oh, I am scared. I haven't done this with anyone. This is the first time.
I also haven't talked to you on a torch all this time.
Just one minute. We can talk on WhatsApp call, voice call.
Ah, don't do it, don't do it, don't do it.
